result.title: Xiaomi-Lens-0 Technical Report
result.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) answer questions about whole images well, yet they still struggle with fine-grained region understanding. A key reason is that text-only supervision never specifies which regions support an answer. To close this gap, we present Xiaomi-Lens-0, a 4B MLLM built on Qwen3.5 that predicts masks from its own visual representations. Specifically, a lightweight decoder combines vision-encoder patch features with visual latents, the language model's mask-token states, so mask supervision reaches the shared backbone without an additional segmentation encoder. Because each latent decodes to a mask, the model can interleave reasoning with region-specific latents and thus think with visual latents, while grounded reasoning traces supervise the regions it visits during chain-of-thought. As a result, across all eight RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg splits, Xiaomi-Lens-0 gains 5.6 points on average over Qwen3.5 in referring comprehension and achieves the highest segmentation cIoU among compared models. Moreover, it surpasses Qwen3.5 across all perception benchmarks. Homepage: \href{https://seerray-lab.github.io/Xiaomi-Lens-0}{this https URL}

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Xiaomi-Lens-0，一个基于 Qwen3.5 的 4B 多模态模型：把语言模型 mask token 的隐状态当作 visual latent，经轻量解码器与视觉编码器 patch 特征结合解码出区域掩码，使模型能在思维链中用区域 latent 交替推理，并以带定位的推理轨迹监督所访问区域。
AI.relevance_reason: 其 latent 本身就是可解码为掩码的隐状态，且用定位轨迹监督 latent 对应区域，直接对应 LVR 关注的视觉信息是否留在内部状态、证据筛选与监督信号问题，可供核查 latent 是否真承载区域细节而非旁路。
